summary: Client only. One of the game's own prefabs (a house with its doors, a wall, a well) built in this game only, as an editor places them while its author works. It stands as the game lays it out in its villages, solid. The server does not know about it, and no other player sees it. A game holds up to 2048, and they end when their resource stops or the world goes. To build one for every player, use Prop.spawn('prefab:<name>') on the server.

place.summary: Builds a prefab in this game, its nested prefabs (doors, sheds) each on their own; the stains a building's walls carry in the game's levels (moss, leaks: its decals) are left out. Throws a RangeError for a name the catalogue does not carry, for one the game cannot build and for a place outside the world, a TypeError for a missing name or position.

params.name: Its path under the game's Prefabs/ folder, or its file name, in any case.
params.orientation: Optional: Euler degrees or a Quaternion. None by default.

place.exampleLua:
-- client
local Vector3 = kcds.math.Vector3

local house = kcds.world.Prefab.place("house_1s_2r_a", Vector3.new(120, 200, 10), Vector3.new(0, 0, 90))
print(house.name)

find.summary: The paths of the prefabs the game can build that contain the text, in any case, in catalogue order.

params.text: Part of a path, such as 'living/houses'.
params.max: Optional: how many at most, up to 200 (the default).

find.exampleLua:
-- client
for _, path in ipairs(kcds.world.Prefab.find("living/houses", 10)) do
  print(path)
end

all.summary: The prefabs your resource placed that still stand.
all.exampleLua:
-- client
for _, prefab in ipairs(kcds.world.Prefab.all()) do
  prefab:destroy()
end

valid.summary: False once it was destroyed or its resource stopped.
valid.exampleLua:
-- client
if house.valid then
  house:destroy()
end

name.summary: Its path under the game's Prefabs/ folder.

position.summary: Its location. Setting it builds the prefab again there.
position.exampleLua:
-- client
local Vector3 = kcds.math.Vector3

house.position = Vector3.new(125, 200, 10)

rotation.summary: The way it faces. Setting it builds the prefab again turned.
rotation.exampleLua:
-- client
local Vector3 = kcds.math.Vector3

house.rotation = Vector3.new(0, 0, 45)

setPose.summary: Moves it in one go, and turns it when a rotation is given.

params.orientation: Optional: Euler degrees or a Quaternion; left out, it keeps its turn.

setPose.exampleLua:
-- client
local Vector3 = kcds.math.Vector3

house:setPose(Vector3.new(125, 205, 10), Vector3.new(0, 0, 180))

destroy.summary: Takes it away. Safe to repeat.
